budget_items.quote: one bid was $20k but the bidder did not submit the required forms. the 2nd bid was very high at $50k so both bids were thrown out.

topics.resolution: discussed; delayed for rebidding under Mass. General Law 30B
topics.quote: it should be advertised as mass. general law 30b, which is a service contract. the previous contract went out as a mass. general law 3039, which is a construction contract.

topics.topic: 100 Laurel Lane pressure line installation bid
topics.quote: bill reported they put out an ifb to install 3 pressure lines from the manhole to the property line at 100 laurel lane and only got 2 bids.

topics.resolution: reported; Francis St. completed, more needed before 8/26
topics.quote: andrew reported they just completed a pump replacement at the francis st. station at a cost of $7,468. there are a couple more that need to be done, hopefully before the contract expires on 8/26.
